name: The 3 Yanderes of Christmas
source:
A take on Charles Dicken’s "A Christmas Carol", where instead of three ghosts, you are visited by three Yanderes over the course of Winter Break.

Can you survive or will you be consumed by their obsessive love? 

[Edited from [url=https://faltazstudio.itch.io/the-3-yanderes-of-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
查尔斯·狄更斯的《圣诞颂歌》的改编版，在寒假期间，你拜访的不是三个鬼魂，而是三个病鬼。

你能活下来还是会被他们痴迷的爱所吞噬？

[编辑自[url=https://faltazstudio.itch.io/the-3-yanderes-of-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
